prompt: In an anime style illustration, a chaotic restaurant kitchen buzzes with activity. On the far left, a chef in a tall white hat chops onions on a wooden board. Next to him stands a sous chef with a blue bandana, who is wiping sweat from his forehead. A stainless steel pot sits on the stove near the center, emitting visible steam clouds. To the right of the pot, a line cook in a black apron flips a pancake in a frying pan. Above the stove, a hanging rack holds three copper pans that gleam under the lights. In the foreground left, a waiter in a yellow vest carries a tray with four steaming bowls. He looks at the head chef, who stands in the center background wearing a crisp white coat. The head chef points firmly at a clipboard held by a manager in a gray suit standing beside him. Near the back door on the right, a dishwasher in green gloves scrubs a large metal sink. A small brown cat sits on top of a refrigerator in the upper right corner, watching the scene below. Below the cat, a stack of dirty plates teeters precariously on a counter. A delivery person in a red helmet hands a cardboard box to the manager in the gray suit. In the lower center, a busboy in a striped shirt picks up a fallen napkin from the tiled floor. Next to the busboy, a spilled bottle of olive oil creates a shiny puddle. A female server with pink hair ties her apron strings while looking at the clock on the wall. The clock shows it is nearly eight o'clock. A customer in a business suit peers through the service window on the far right, observing the chaos. There is no fire in the oven. There is no dog in the kitchen. There is no television screen on the wall.
